chunks: If you miss the prayer over the deceased until he is buried, there is no harm in praying over him after he has been buried.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: the funeral prayer offered for the deceased
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Can salat over the deceased be performed after burial if it was missed before burial?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat over the deceased. It states that if the funeral prayer was missed before burial, it is still permissible to perform it after the deceased has been buried.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.475 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"If you miss the funeral prayer for the deceased until they are buried, there is no problem in performing the prayer for them after they have been buried”.
